info.text:
A gallon of gas costs $1.13 more than a year ago.
AAA national average: $4.17 today (Nov 2) vs $3.04 a year ago, even after falling about 23 cents in a month.
October averaged $4.31 (EIA), the highest October since at least 1990. October 2022 was $3.82.
Diesel: $6.29 vs $3.68 a year ago. AAA says crude above $100 a barrel is the culprit.
Our math: a 15-gallon fill-up costs $17 more than last year.
Sources: AAA (Nov 2, 2026); U.S. Energy Information Administration; Reuters (Nov 2).
News and education, not financial advice.
